text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even now, Tosen Jordan still wonders if a 
smarter girl could have made better use of 
her Trainer's talents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still, when my Trainer told me to aim for 
it, I felt that becoming the "ultimate 
fool" was something only I could do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They say the strongest competitors are 
gathering once again for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn). But more than that... no, she 
will run faster than anyone in history.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"That is why she declared it to her 
friends and to the media: that she was the 
ultimate fool... and the Umamusume who was 
destined to make it big!"
